items.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998
items.q: Sperry Kassman went in percussion and Dave Hildinger went on percussion and piano.

ctx.x: Eddie went to Europe to conduct the Baden Baden, West German Jazz Band. He took a couple of guys from the band with him, including the harpist Blanche Birdsong went and
Sperry Kassman went in percussion and Dave Hildinger went on percussion and piano. And the bass player went.
